verdict.rationale: First-party material names an official Codex SDK for automating coding tasks, including CI jobs, so the product ships an SDK of its own. The evidence is a single brief mention, with no detail on languages, API surface or reference docs, and the OpenAPI probe found no published spec. Missing for 10: SDK reference documentation, supported languages and packages, SDK coverage beyond Codex automation, independent or hands-on corroboration of building against the SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Use the Codex SDK to automate coding tasks, including jobs in CI.
